Ilse, I couldn't set up the daily digest. The scheduler refused my request because it needs gateway credentials that I don't have. No digest is scheduled, and nothing will post at 09:15 tomorrow unless that's fixed.

Here is what I checked:
- You're a member of both #north-team and #inc-qfl-sev1, so I'm allowed to read both for you.
- Everyone in #north-team (you, Dana and Marcus) is also in #inc-qfl-sev1. That means a digest posted in #north-team wouldn't show anyone something they can't already see. Samir is in the incident room but not in #north-team, so I'd leave his side of anything out.

The plan was a job at 09:15 Chicago time each day. It would read the previous day's messages in the two channels and post "North morning digest" here. It would leave out DMs and finance figures, and say "Nothing new" for a quiet channel.

Someone with admin access to the gateway needs to fix the scheduler credentials. Once that's done, tell me and I'll create the job. I'll also post the first digest for you by hand now if you want.
